blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Six a plus five minus two a plus three.
The a terms are six a and negative two a. Six minus two is four, so four a.
The constants are five and three. Five plus three is eight. A terms and constants are not alike, so we stop.
So the answer is four a plus eight.
Watch out for these traps. If you add every number into one a term, you get twelve a. If you forget the minus in front of two a, you get eight a plus eight.
